Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 53

“When your understanding, bewildered by scriptural teachings, stands unmoving and steady in absorption, then you will attain yoga.”

Krishna acknowledges that scripture itself can bewilder, with conflicting instructions pulling in different directions. The resolution is not another text but a steadiness that no longer needs to be told.
